messages:
Nora Patel: quick FYI 3:04 UTC we started dark-launch of strict-fn-schema v3 for customer-invoices and the alerting shows an immediate bump in fncall validation rejects, lots hitting the degen route. console sampling empty though.
Sam Wu: which validator error are you seeing in logs?
Nora Patel: e.g. `validate_fncall: missing required 'invoice.items[].price'` and another `unexpected type: 'string' for discounts` in the same namespace.
Lena Morales: did the schema change require price to be numeric? I remember a PR that tightened types.
Victor Tan: yep PR #9012 changed price -> number and tightened discounts to array of objects. That was the dark-launch.
Nora Patel: can we get samples into console? support needs examples to tell customers. right now the route detail shows zero samples for degen.
Sam Wu: sampler job is filtering on `route_type='tool'` instead of route_id like degen. looks like the new degen route id isn't included in the join. opening fix PR.
Lena Morales: product asks for a quick UX tweak: show "validation: <field>" badge in route timeline when we route to degen so users see the reason without a sample. filed CON-2199.
Victor Tan: billing concern: are these rejects billed toward committed reserved capacity? we had an incident where rejects inflated committed usage.
billing-bot: alert: invoice-namespace usage spike detected. Note: validation_rejects currently preserve quota_tag but drop `route_id` in the metering window.
Sam Wu: ah that explains the billing ambiguity. I'll work with metering to stop dropping route_id for reject responses. opening tracker MET-3345.
Nora Patel: short-term mitigation thought: have the validator return a structured error payload (JSON) with fields `code`, `reason`, `field_path`, and `remediation_link`, plus header `x-rw-fn-reject: schema:invoice.items.price`. SDKs can show it.
Lena Morales: good. also add a small sample of the bad payload in the response body for support to copy. make sure PII-safe.
Victor Tan: ops note: If we add that header, can the load balancer or current proxies strip it? need to ensure propagation to billing and console pipelines.
Sam Wu: confirmed proxies preserve `x-` headers. metering pipeline is the weak link. MET-3345 will stop the `route_id` drop.
ops-bot: deployment event: strict-fn-schema-v3 dark-launch -> hosts d-3004. deploy in progress.
Nora Patel: sample log for trace:
```
2026-03-05T13:04:11Z invoke_id=inv-551 route=degen model=gpt-infer-1 error=validate_fncall missing invoice.items[0].price quota_tag=reserved-eu-42
```
Lena Morales: can we also add a console-level fallback UI: when route=degen show a "why" panel with header and remediation link even if there is no sample? low-effort and helps support.
Sam Wu: agree. I can add a temporary panel that surfaces the `x-rw-fn-reject` header and JSON body if present. filed RD-1502.
Victor Tan: let's also set an alert: if validation_reject_rate > 0.8% for 10m revert dark-launch.
Nora Patel: agreed. I'm watching metrics. will post PR links when they land.
Sam Wu: PRs: sampler fix #9040, metering preserve-route #9041, structured-reject-header #9042.
Lena Morales: product asked for copy for the "how to fix" tips; i'll draft and attach to CON-2199.
billing-bot: note added to MET-3345: ensure rejects don't attribute to committed throughput until route_id preserved.
Nora Patel: thanks team. will update in 30m after sampler PR merges to confirm console samples show up.
